categories.hint: Per specialist: houses in matching city type x VP printed on that card. Enter each card total.

tiebreakers.description: Player holding the Praefectus Magnus wins; otherwise the tied player who would receive it next

notes: family: auction-money (card-purchase end-game god scoring). Game ends when the last display card is bought or a player builds their 15th house; that player takes the Concordia card (+7 VP) and all others play one last turn. Venus scoring wording per PD-Verlag combined rules (Venus edition) which restate base scoring; the Venus and Legatus cards are not in the base game and are not modelled. Optional intermediate scoring (first Tribune play) awards sestertii, not VP; not modelled. Saturnus is naturally capped by province count (Imperium 12, Italia 11).
